class.name: GDScript
class.brief_description: A script implemented in the GDScript programming language.
class.description: A script implemented in the GDScript programming language, saved with the [code].gd[/code] extension. The script extends the functionality of all objects that instantiate it. Calling [method new] creates a new instance of the script. [method Object.set_script] extends an existing object, if that object's class matches one of the script's base classes. If you are looking for GDScript's built-in functions, see [@GDScript] instead.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the first parser, analyzer, or compiler message from the most recent [method Script.reload], or an empty string if that reload succeeded. The error is cleared at the start of every reload and is intended for editor validation tools; it is not a runtime exception.

method.name: get_last_error_kind
method.description: Returns the stage of the most recent [method Script.reload] failure: [code]parse[/code] or [code]compile[/code]. Returns an empty string when the last reload succeeded.

method.name: get_last_error_line
method.description: Returns the one-based source line of the most recent [method Script.reload] failure, or [code]0[/code] when the last reload succeeded or the line is unknown.

method.name: new
